info.title: CraftSky moderation console API
info.description: Private operator API served by AppView. Atmosphere login/bootstrap is specified separately in internal/operatorconsole/openapi.json. No operator bearer authentication, PDS writes, external transmission or unrestricted media fetch is provided. JSON uses camelCase. Safety command receipts store a digest and safe response, never raw requests or restricted bytes.

get.description: Helpers may read only an actively assigned incident. No restricted bytes, subject URIs or object keys are included.

post.description: Unsafe requests require the exact console Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Actor and source are server-derived. An existing resource requires expectedRevision. Successful safety commands replay their original response with Idempotent-Replayed: true; changed keys after conflict require a fresh review.

appealRationale.description: Private operator rationale for the resolved appeal; may be absent for earlier appeals.

Preview.description: Indexed content for the case version. Changed records and terminal owners are unavailable; incident-linked subjects are restricted. Only clear image projections and already published profile image fields supply ordinary media URLs. Restricted evidence is never included.

header_Idempotency_Key.name: Idempotency-Key
header_Idempotency_Key.description: Reuse the exact payload, route and key after an uncertain outcome. Changed input with the same actor/key returns 409.
